title: Flowers On Main in Ecru sets Sunday open house for 1 to 4 p.m.
excerpt: The florist at 399 Main St. will tie bows on site. Its event overlaps with the Chamber’s Christmas open house in Pontotoc, which runs noon to 5 p.m.

facts.statement: Flowers On Main will hold its ninth annual Christmas open house from 1 to 4 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 22, at 399 Main St. in Ecru. The town shared the florist’s invitation Saturday. The date and hours appear on the accompanying flyer.
facts.evidence: Inspected the dated flyer. The post calls it the ninth annual event. Its pickup number exactly matches the florist’s address and telephone listing.
facts.statistics: Ninth annual; Nov. 22; 1–4 p.m.; 399 Main St.
facts.date_context: Town notice shared Saturday, November 21. Both events take place Sunday, November 22, 2026, Central time.
facts.identities: Flowers On Main, Town of Ecru and Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street.

paragraphs.text: Flowers On Main will hold its ninth annual Christmas open house from 1 to 4 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 22, at 399 Main St. in Ecru. The town shared the florist’s invitation Saturday. The date and hours appear on the accompanying flyer.

Staff will tie tree-topper bows and other bows on site. The shop will also take orders for silk cemetery arrangements, and the flyer lists mailbox toppers at $25. Anyone hoping to pick up an order during the open house can call the shop ahead at 662-200-2676.

Shoppers planning stops in both towns have a wider window in Pontotoc. The county Chamber lists its city Christmas open house from noon to 5 p.m., starting an hour before the Ecru florist opens and ending an hour after it closes.
